2026-2027.summary: The Outsiders reported a sharp 53% gross decline week-over-week across its national tour stops, falling from $1.53M to $722K in the week of September 6. This week's data reflects a thinner evidence base than typical for early September, drawing from three records across two venues rather than the monthly average of one. The significant contraction signals weakened near-term demand across The Outsiders' touring markets.
